pull_request.title: Magnet System: prototype twelvefold toroids and joint solenoid field
pull_request.head: codex/twelvefold-toroid-prototype
pull_request.body:
This PR extends unmerged PR #86 with an isolated **DRAFT / PROTOTYPE** twelvefold air-core muon toroid: 12 barrel coils and 12 coils per endcap, staggered by 15°, plus the pinned 3 T solenoid. Three 500 mm chamber envelopes in the barrel and three disks per side retain 3 m first-to-last measurement spans; no chamber internals are designed.

The PR87 review prompted a wider barrel window and relocated disks. Barrel station radii are 5.2/6.7/8.2 m, disks are at |z|=8/9.5/11 m, BT legs are at R=4.6/8.8 m, and ECT legs are at R=0.7/7.6 m over |z|=6.8–11.7 m. True XY and fixed-azimuth RZ sections distinguish finite winding packs, energy-sized cold allocation, warm reservations, retained/excluded chamber envelopes and pinned solenoid/HCAL bounds.

On the same 28,800 cell-centred straight-ray grid over |eta|≤3, solid-angle-weighted three-envelope coverage changes about **66%→96%**, and three envelopes with a clear interstation route **65%→93%**. Remaining transition/forward holes, local losses and upstream coil shadows are explicit. These are geometric diagnostics, not reconstruction efficiencies; no eta acceptance requirement is adopted. The original proposal remains reproducible at 71406b09fa2d3fbfa119dba61e436f8fad1d11ac.

Fresh currents are 2.985344/1.745396 MA-turn per barrel/endcap coil, preserving signed 1 T barrel /1.6 T eta=2 references. Complete all-space vacuum energy is **4.780818 GJ**, about 20.4% above the original geometry; the radial magnet bound grows about 0.70 m while maximum |z| remains 12.05 m. The joint vector map retains 3,006,297 nodes, 6.25 cm R/Z and 0.625° sampling, explicit masks and bounded interpolation.

Validation: **49 targeted controls pass**; a separate frozen-revision PhysVal assessment and paired old/new response checks are retained. At 3,066 clear-path probes, sampled interpolation RMS is 0.800 mT and maximum error 9.61 mT /1.60% of local field norm. Complete self/mutual energy, cold-union accounting and refinement controls are retained. HCAL nonlinear steel response, conductor margins, common endcap vessel, forces, supports and quench remain open; no engineering sign-off or production integration.

- [Design amendment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/design/DES-039-twelvefold-toroid.md)
- [Results, coverage and reproduction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/results.md)
- [XY occupied-space slices](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/review-coverage/xy-envelope.png)
- [RZ occupied-space slices](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/review-coverage/rz-envelope.png)
- [Coverage comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/review-coverage/coverage.png)
- [Joint field](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/joint-field.png)

comments.body: Can you provide an xy view and an rz view of the chambers and the toroids of the magnetic field and their space coverage

To add to @dimitra97 - the current drawings do not show how much space the coils need to provide such a field and how this interleaves with the 3 layers of chambers. We would still require a as-good-as-possible coverage over the full acceptance range.

Addressed both [the XY/RZ request](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/87#issuecomment-6264270956) and [the coil-space/coverage concern](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/87#issuecomment-6264387576).

The new views show actual finite winding, cold and warm space, 500 mm chamber envelopes and their cutouts, with joint vacuum-field contours. The old coil window could fit only a 2.4 m clear measurement span, so the revised proposal widens it and relocates the disks while keeping the requested 3 m spans.

For the same sampled |eta|≤3 domain, solid-angle-weighted three-envelope coverage improves about 66%→96%; requiring a clear interstation route gives 65%→93%. Transition holes and upstream coil material remain explicit; these are geometry diagnostics, not efficiencies. The field, currents, all-space energy and cold volume were recalculated. The larger layout costs about 20% more vacuum energy (4.78 GJ). All 49 targeted tests pass.

![True XY occupied-space sections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/review-coverage/xy-envelope.png)

![True RZ occupied-space sections](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/review-coverage/rz-envelope.png)

[Coverage plots, before/after numbers, numerical checks and remaining limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/875a2db7a8510bcc553b6864a282542a4ac161d0/docs/validation/DES-039/results.md).
Can you provide this design with rectangular barrel chambers and trapezoidal chambers for the endcaps.

Indeed, this we should do in a new PR: taking this magnetic field layout and see if we can fit a chamber design in it, that covers 4pi but is realistic.

In this design, we should make the coils also be connected and held by a frame and introduce feet.

Followed up in separate PR #90 as requested: whole rectangular barrel and trapezoidal endcap chamber envelopes, a connected frame, endcap carriers and ten feet on the unchanged PR87 magnetic layout/map. The new PR includes true 3D/XY/RZ views, finite-volume/contact checks and an independent frozen-revision assessment. The full-4pi study exposes the remaining gaps: three-station availability is 74.35% for outer envelopes, 63.20% with the assumed inactive border, and 41.38% for complete depth traversal. These are geometric proxies, not efficiency; this bounded first packing is not hermetic. Structural loads/qualification and chamber services/mounts remain open.
